title: Add schema migration framework to SqliteMemorySmithDatabase
description:
P0 (blocking): `SqliteMemorySmithDatabase.cs` has a single hardcoded migration (`"20260517_auth_rbac_audit_history_v1"`). All 13 tables are created via `CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS` inside a single `ApplyInitialMigrationAsync`. There is no `ALTER TABLE` anywhere and no mechanism to register/apply a second migration. TSK-0201 and TSK-0202 need new tables/columns and cannot deploy without this.

Scope:
- Introduce `IReadOnlyList<(string Id, string Sql)>` ordered migration list applied in a loop against `SchemaMigrations` table
- Replace single `ApplyInitialMigrationAsync` call with migration runner
- Keep existing `SchemaMigrations` table structure for compatibility
- Ensure `SqliteAgentSessionStore`'s own migration (which registers separately) still works
- Add test: new migration added and auto-applied successfully

Evidence: memorysmith-deep-audit-20260703.md §8, MemorySmith-Audit-Delta-5-20260702.md, council/audit-synthesis-council-20260705.md

comments.author: AgentSmith
comments.body: Created from 6-seat council audit synthesis. Data Model Architect rated at 92% confidence. Blocks TSK-0201 and TSK-0202 from shipping new tables/columns. Design question: should migration rollback be supported?
